title: 第2章 无限流业务都拓展到异界来了？

content_zh:
回来的途中，遇到了无数宫女太监乃至于侍卫。
但这些人见到苏景之后，却都是一愣，然后目不斜视的过去，仿佛看不到他一般。
没办法……楚国之后，偏偏又带着今上皇室血脉，懈怠不得亲近不得，也只能冷处理了……
也正是因为这样，整个十年间，与楚南说过话的人，竟然屈指可数，一个小小孩童，没有疯掉，只能说，这小子果然也不简单呐。
而此时，苏景突然成为楚南，却也没有心思为自己以后的处境而担忧。
用最快的速度回到了属于自己那破败的院落。
院内空无一人，冷清的仿佛冷宫一般。
事实上……
这里比冷宫更为残酷，只因为就与这里一墙之隔的外面，是一处幽幽的荒林，堆着足足近三十万具皑皑白骨！
阿房宫尊贵奢华，三步一廊，五步一亭，玉檐飞瓦，阁楼林立……这是牺牲了楚国足足十七万无辜百姓，以及十三万精锐将士的性命才搭建起来！
尸体无处安放，索性堆在阿房宫中的一处偏僻角落，用以震慑前朝遗民！
而事后……在安排皇子居所的时候，就顺势把楚南也给安排到这里来了。
纵然苏景对秦皇政没什么感觉，也不得不感慨，竟然让自己的儿子住在乱丧岗里，这家伙也是个狠角色！
“倒也方便了，最起码如果无缘无故死了，连收尸都不用！”
苏景为自己将来坎坷的命运感叹了一句，嘀咕了下，小心的把根本不设防的院门关上，然后房门也都紧紧关上。
他举起了自己的左腕。
上面，一个跟身处环境截然不同，极富现代科技的手表正戴在上面。
“轮回表吗？我到底是穿越了，还是说，现在其实正在无限世界里面？”
苏景从一开始就注意到手腕上的这个表，闪烁着幽幽的蓝光，一排数字在上面闪烁……但因为怕被人发现不对，他之前都不敢看，所以到现在，才把注意力集中到了上面！
【宿主：苏景楚南】

【气运值：835！】
【偏差值：72！】
似乎只有自己能看到，最起码，之前楚南身上是万万没有这块表的，而其他人，也没有因为这表的造型而感到吃惊。
“所以，我突然出现在这里，还有了这么个糟心的身份，是因为你么？”
苏景的手在轮回表上轻轻拂过……
突然，仿如电击般，眼神陷入了呆滞，而思维，更是仿佛化作了实质，被吸到了这块轮回表之内。
霎时间，周围那陈旧的环境立时消失，取而代之的，是无尽的星空，仿佛宇宙一般漆黑的世界里，无尽的星星点点……苏景就这么悬浮在空中，身躯显的无比的渺小！
而每一个星星，都是一个世界！
无数信息仿佛潮水一般向着他的大脑涌去！
无限世界……现世……元辰大陆……以及……无尽的轮回世界，必须完成的任务……
很温润的灌输记忆方式，明明多到比自己过往二十多年的记忆还要多，但苏景却并没有什么头疼的感觉，反而就那么轻而易举的接纳了这些信息。
良久之后。
星辰散去！
还是那破旧的房屋。
但苏景脸上，却露出了古怪的神情，喃喃道：“所以说……无限流就是给力啊，现在拓展业务都拓展到异界来了？而且这个主神代理是怎么回事？”
正自困惑着，耳边响起了机械式的声音。
是来自于主神的声音。
【主神试炼，是否开始？】
声音来自于手腕上的轮回表，随着说话，上面的光芒一闪一闪，颇为耀眼。
苏景却没什么震惊的表情，问道：“什么是主神试炼？”

那声音答道：【主神试炼，成功则成为代理主神，代为监管该位面所有轮回者！失败，则可抹消记忆，送回原位面！】
“送回？这么说，我还有机会返回原世界不成？”
苏景顿时松了口气。
【是的，试炼失败后，抹杀灵魂，复制身体和记忆，送回原世界！】
“那不就是抹杀吗，就算复制记忆，那也不是我了啊。”
苏景顿时无语，心道业务拓展的再怎么大，这客户感受也太不注重了，他不死心的再度问道：“那么我可以问一下，所谓代理主神，你们之前试炼过多少个呢？”

content_en:
On the way back, I met countless palace maids, eunuchs and even guards.
But when these people saw Su Jing, they were all stunned for a moment, and then looked at him intently, as if they couldn't see him.
There is no way... After the Chu Kingdom, he happened to have the blood of the current royal family. He could not slack off and could not get close to each other, so he could only deal with it coldly...
It is precisely because of this that during the entire ten years, there were only a handful of people who had spoken to Chu Nan. He was not a little kid, but he was not crazy. I can only say that this kid was indeed not simple.
At this time, Su Jing suddenly became Chu Nan, but he had no intention of worrying about his future situation.
He returned to his dilapidated courtyard as quickly as possible.
There was no one in the courtyard, as deserted as a cold palace.
In fact...
This place is even more cruel than the Cold Palace, just because there is a secluded forest just outside the wall, with nearly 300,000 white bones piled up!
Epang Palace is noble and luxurious, with three steps to a corridor, five steps to a pavilion, jade eaves and flying tiles, and numerous attics... This was built at the expense of the lives of 170,000 innocent people and 130,000 elite soldiers of Chu State!
There was nowhere to put the corpses, so they were simply piled up in a remote corner of Afang Palace to frighten the survivors of the previous dynasty!
And afterwards... when arranging the prince's residence, Chu Nan was arranged here as well.
Even though Su Jing had no feelings for Qin Huangzheng, he still had to lament that he let his son live in Luan Sang Gang. This guy was also a ruthless character!
"It's quite convenient. At least if you die for no reason, you don't even have to collect the body!"
Su Jing sighed for his rough fate in the future, muttered, and carefully closed the undefended courtyard door, and then closed the door tightly.
He raised his left wrist.
Above, a watch that is completely different from the surrounding environment and full of modern technology is worn on it.
"Reincarnation table? Have I traveled through time, or am I actually in an infinite world now?"
Su Jing noticed the watch on his wrist from the very beginning. It was flashing with a faint blue light and a row of numbers flashing on it... But because he was afraid that someone would find something wrong, he didn't dare to look at it before, so he only focused on it now!
[Host: Su Jingchunan]
[Luck value: 835! 】
[Deviation value: 72! 】
It seemed that only he could see it. At least, Chu Nan had never had this watch on him before, and no one else was surprised by the shape of the watch.
"So, I suddenly appeared here and had such a terrible identity, is it because of you?"
Su Jing's hand gently brushed over the reincarnation table...
Suddenly, like an electric shock, his eyes became dull, and his thoughts seemed to turn into substance and were sucked into the reincarnation table.
In an instant, the old environment around him disappeared, replaced by the endless starry sky. In the dark world like the universe, there were endless stars... Su Jing was suspended in the air, his body looking extremely small!
And every star is a world!
Countless information poured into his brain like a tide!
The infinite world...the current world...the Yuanchen Continent...and...the endless world of reincarnation, the tasks that must be completed...
It was a very gentle way of instilling memories, and it was obviously more memories than he had in the past twenty years, but Su Jing didn't feel any headache, and instead accepted the information so easily.
After a long time.
The stars disperse!
It's still that dilapidated house.
But there was a strange look on Su Jing's face, and he murmured: "So... Infinite Flow is awesome, and now it has expanded its business to other worlds? And what's going on with this main god agent?"
While I was confused, a mechanical voice sounded in my ears.
It is the voice from the Lord God.
【Lord GodTrial, shall we begin? 】
The sound came from the reincarnation watch on his wrist. As he spoke, the light on it flashed and was quite dazzling.
Su Jing, however, showed no signs of shock and asked, "What is the Lord God Trial?"
The voice replied: [The main god is tested. If you succeed, you will become the acting main god and supervise all the reincarnations in the plane! If it fails, the memory can be erased and sent back to the original plane! 】
"Send it back? So, I still have a chance to return to the original world?"
Su Jing suddenly breathed a sigh of relief.
[Yes, after failing the trial, the soul will be wiped out, the body and memory will be copied, and sent back to the original world! 】
"Isn't that just erasure? Even if the memory is copied, it's not me anymore."
Su Jing was speechless. No matter how much Xindao's business expanded, it still paid too little attention to customer experience. He asked again without giving up: "Then I can ask, how many so-called acting master gods have you tried before?"
